empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

editor.title: Configuration
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — write it as a directive instruction describing WHEN to apply the skill, not just a summary of what it covers.

commitMessage.title: What changed?
commitMessage.label: Summary
commitMessage.hint: Recorded on the new version, like a commit message.

stats.none: Not linked to any agent yet.
stats.metricsComingSoon: Pull-frequency, accept-rate, and findings-by-category will show up here once the eval pipeline (a later lesson) attributes findings back to the skill that flagged them.

versions.title: Version history
versions.description: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: The body becomes instructions in every agent's prompt once enabled — imported skills are saved disabled until you review them.
file.success: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you vet + enable it.
file.confirmHint: Saves as disabled — review the body, then enable it from the skill's Config tab.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
